models_evaluated: AI-based bowel preparation assessment smartphone app (image classification of fecal photographs)

links.outcome: Adequate bowel preparation rate and BBPS score, AI app vs control, in randomized trial
links.effect: Adequate preparation 88.54% vs 65.59% (P<0.001); mean BBPS 6.74±1.25 vs 5.97±1.81 (P<0.001); higher compliance with dietary and purgative instructions.
links.quote: In the full analysis set (n = 500), adequate preparation is significantly higher in the AI-driven app group (88.54 vs. 65.59%; P < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: AI-driven patient-facing smartphone app with image-based feedback to improve bowel preparation adherence

screen.reason: Prospective randomized clinical trial testing the efficacy of an AI-driven smartphone app assessing bowel preparation images to improve colonoscopy prep quality compared to standard care.
